test_AttrDict_immutability: test the AttrDict class immutability feature to lock nested config values recursively
test_cfg_deepcopy: test the cfg global config object can be deep copied without mutating the original
test_merge_cfg_from_cfg: test merging config values from one AttrDict config object into the global cfg singleton
test_merge_cfg_from_file: test loading and merging config values from a YAML file into the global cfg
test_merge_cfg_from_list: test merging config key-value pairs from a command-line style list into the global cfg
